intro: Turn merged pull requests that close an issue into tasks: the issue text is the instruction, the repository before the fix is the start, the pull request's tests grade the agent. Python with pytest for now.
consent: Send your code to your model provider with your key to build and check each issue

fixPrompt.add_secret: Name of the secret to add (from Secrets)

none: No usable issues in this repository.

stage.build: Building the environment on a worker
stage.validate: Running the tests on a worker

readiness.noWorker: No worker online: building and testing issues runs on a worker, never on the server. Add a worker or turn on the shared worker.
readiness.noGateway: This server has no model gateway, so environments can not be built. The operator starts the shared-runner profile.
readiness.startNoGateway: Start needs the server's model gateway
